clues.text: Near Mamre in Canaan, he buried his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah.
Sitting at his tent entrance by the Oaks of Mamre, he ran to meet three men and bowed low.
Pleading with the LORD over Sodom, he asked again and again until God agreed to spare it for ten righteous people.
God gave him a new name, saying He had made him a father of many nations.
He was a hundred years old when his long-awaited son was finally born to him.
Melchizedek, king of Salem, met him returning from the slaughter of the kings and blessed him.
In a story Jesus told, a rich man in Hades looked up and saw him far off, with Lazarus by his side.
